events.title: 입스위치 타운 beat 아스널 3–0 and 번리 are held by 블랙번 로버스 in the East Lancashire derby , giving Town a two-point lead over 번리 at the top of Division One. In the race to evade joining already-relegated 첼시 in next season's second-tier, 카디프 시티 pick up a useful win against 웨스트햄 유나이티드, while fellow strugglers 풀럼 were beaten by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 . Both Cardiff and 풀럼 are on 31 points, but the West Londoners have one game more left to play compared with the Bluebirds. In the Second Division, 레이턴 오리엔트 's win over 루턴 타운 ensures the East London club continue to chase Scunthorpe and 선덜랜드 for the last remaining promotion spot.

입스위치 타운, in the First Division for the first time, are crowned champions of English club football with a 2–0 win at home 애스턴 빌라 on the last day of the league season. It is the first major trophy of their history, and the first time that an English club has won the title in their first season as a top division club.
